selection.summary: Terminal review: bug concerns notifications dropdown async load/toggle races and dropup class on category selector in fork/move modals. Selected full-range base evidence: h0 (threadTools.js 180-279, contains dropup toggle at line 211 in modal category selector), h4 (threadTools.js 200-219, precise dropup toggle region), h2 (header/notifications.js 1-42, dropdown open/loadNotifications trigger paths), h1 (notifications.js 1-100, Notifications.loadNotifications implementation including callback usage), h7 (notifications.js 20-59, loadNotifications core region). These cover both the dropup placement issue and the async notification refresh race surface; other handles are duplicates/narrower slices and omitted.
